source: schema.ts (2026-07-28, all 3197 lines) — focus C: MRTR (InputRequiredResult/InputRequests/InputResponses/requestState), elicitation, sampling, roots, logging, cancellation, progress, extension hooks; cross-checked against pages: basic/patterns/mrtr.md, client/elicitation.md, client/sampling.md, client/roots.md, server/utilities/logging.md, basic/patterns/cancellation.md, basic/patterns/progress.md, basic/index.md (_meta, error codes, resultType), basic/versioning.md, deprecated.md, changelog.md, extensions/overview.md; legacy delta from 2025-11-25_schema.ts and 2025-06-18_schema.ts.
summary: 2026-07-28 removes server-initiated JSON-RPC requests entirely. Servers obtain client input (elicitation/create, sampling/createMessage, roots/list) only via the Multi Round-Trip Request (MRTR) pattern: on tools/call, prompts/get or resources/read (and NO other method) the server may answer with a Result whose resultType is "input_required" (InputRequiredResult) carrying an inputRequests map (server-assigned unique keys -> ElicitRequest | CreateMessageRequest | ListRootsRequest, each a bare {method, params} object with no jsonrpc/id) and/or an opaque requestState string; at least one MUST be present. The client fulfils the requests, then re-issues the ORIGINAL request with a NEW JSON-RPC id, adding inputResponses (same keys -> ElicitResult | CreateMessageResult | ListRootsResult, which are bare objects without resultType/_meta) and echoing requestState byte-for-byte. Servers must treat requestState as attacker-controlled (HMAC/AEAD, principal/TTL/request binding). Elicitation (active) has form mode (flat requestedSchema of String/Number/Boolean/Enum incl. titled oneOf/anyOf, multi-select arrays, legacy enumNames) and url mode (message+url; elicitationId and notifications/elicitation/complete removed). ElicitResult.action in accept|decline|cancel. Sampling, Roots and Logging are DEPRECATED (SEP-2577, earliest removal >=2027-07-28) but fully specified: sampling keeps tools/toolChoice, ToolUseContent/ToolResultContent, ModelPreferences/ModelHint, stopReason incl. "toolUse"; includeContext thisServer/allServers deprecated. Logging is opt-in per request via _meta "io.modelcontextprotocol/logLevel" (logging/setLevel removed) and notifications/message is request-stream scoped. notifications/cancelled is client->server (stdio only; HTTP cancels by closing the stream) and server->client solely to end a subscriptions/listen stream. Progress via _meta.progressToken. Extensions are negotiated via capabilities.extensions maps keyed by prefixed identifiers (e.g. io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks, io.modelcontextprotocol/ui); reserved _meta keys are enumerated.

methods.name: tools/call (MRTR-capable client request)
methods.capability_gate: Server must advertise ServerCapabilities.tools (else MethodNotFound -32601). Input requests embedded in the InputRequiredResult are gated by client capabilities declared in _meta['io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities'] (elicitation.form/url, sampling(.tools/.context), roots).
methods.params: CallToolRequestParams extends InputResponseRequestParams: _meta: RequestMetaObject (required; must contain 'io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion': string and 'io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities': ClientCapabilities; optional 'io.modelcontextprotocol/clientInfo': Implementation, 'io.modelcontextprotocol/logLevel': LoggingLevel [deprecated], progressToken: string|number); name: string (required); arguments?: {[k:string]: unknown}; inputResponses?: InputResponses ({[key:string]: CreateMessageResult|ListRootsResult|ElicitResult}); requestState?: string. (schema.ts l.597-609, 1863-1872)
methods.result: CallToolResultResponse.result: CallToolResult | InputRequiredResult (schema.ts l.1848-1850). CallToolResult: resultType 'complete'; content: ContentBlock[]; structuredContent?: unknown; isError?: boolean; _meta?: ResultMetaObject. InputRequiredResult: resultType 'input_required'; inputRequests?: InputRequests; requestState?: string (at least one MUST be present, l.575, 584-595). Not CacheableResult.
methods.notes: Every retry is an independent request with a different id (mrtr.md Client Req 3). Servers MAY return InputRequiredResult repeatedly (mrtr.md Server Req 8).

methods.name: prompts/get (MRTR-capable client request)
methods.capability_gate: ServerCapabilities.prompts; embedded input requests gated by client capabilities as for tools/call.
methods.params: GetPromptRequestParams extends InputResponseRequestParams: _meta (required, as above); name: string (required); arguments?: {[k:string]: string}; inputResponses?: InputResponses; requestState?: string (schema.ts l.1602-1611)
methods.result: GetPromptResultResponse.result: GetPromptResult | InputRequiredResult (l.1650-1652). GetPromptResult: resultType; description?: string; messages: PromptMessage[] (role: 'user'|'assistant'; content: ContentBlock).
methods.notes: Only prompts/get, resources/read and tools/call may return InputRequiredResult (mrtr.md 'Supported Requests'; ServerResult union l.3185-3197 includes InputRequiredResult).

methods.name: resources/read (MRTR-capable client request)
methods.capability_gate: ServerCapabilities.resources; embedded input requests gated by client capabilities.
methods.params: ReadResourceRequestParams extends ResourceRequestParams, InputResponseRequestParams: _meta (required); uri: string (required, @format uri); inputResponses?: InputResponses; requestState?: string (l.1191-1206)
methods.result: ReadResourceResultResponse.result: ReadResourceResult | InputRequiredResult (l.1244-1246). ReadResourceResult extends CacheableResult: resultType; contents: (TextResourceContents|BlobResourceContents)[]; ttlMs: number (>=0, required); cacheScope: 'public'|'private' (required).
methods.notes: Note asymmetry: the 'complete' branch is CacheableResult (ttlMs/cacheScope required) while the InputRequiredResult branch is a plain Result.

methods.name: elicitation/create (input request, carried in InputRequiredResult.inputRequests)
methods.direction: server->client (embedded in a result; NOT a JSON-RPC request)
methods.capability_gate: Client MUST declare ClientCapabilities.elicitation on each request (elicitation.md 'Capabilities'); empty object {} == {form:{}}; server MUST NOT send a mode the client did not declare (elicitation.md; InvalidParams -32602 is listed for 'Server requests an elicitation mode not declared in client capabilities', schema.ts l.370). Client declaring elicitation MUST support at least one of form/url.
methods.params: ElicitRequest = { method: 'elicitation/create'; params: ElicitRequestFormParams | ElicitRequestURLParams } (l.2856-2859). No jsonrpc, no id, no _meta field defined on params. ElicitRequestFormParams: mode?: 'form' (absent == form); message: string (required); requestedSchema: { $schema?: string; type: 'object'; properties: {[k:string]: PrimitiveSchemaDefinition}; required?: string[] } (required) (l.2788-2811). ElicitRequestURLParams: mode: 'url' (required); message: string (required); url: string (required, @format uri) (l.2821-2838). NO elicitationId field exists in 2026-07-28. PrimitiveSchemaDefinition = StringSchema | NumberSchema | BooleanSchema | EnumSchema (l.2867-2868). StringSchema: type 'string'; title?, description?: string; minLength?, maxLength?: number; format?: 'email'|'uri'|'date'|'date-time'; default?: string. NumberSchema: type 'number'|'integer'; title?, description?; minimum?, maximum?, default?: number. BooleanSchema: type 'boolean'; title?, description?; default?: boolean. EnumSchema = SingleSelectEnumSchema | MultiSelectEnumSchema | LegacyTitledEnumSchema. UntitledSingleSelectEnumSchema: type 'string'; title?, description?; enum: string[]; default?: string. TitledSingleSelectEnumSchema: type 'string'; title?, description?; oneOf: Array<{const: string; title: string}>; default?: string. UntitledMultiSelectEnumSchema: type 'array'; title?, description?; minItems?, maxItems?: number; items: {type:'string'; enum: string[]}; default?: string[]. TitledMultiSelectEnumSchema: type 'array'; title?, description?; minItems?, maxItems?; items: {anyOf: Array<{const: string; title: string}>}; default?: string[]. LegacyTitledEnumSchema (to be removed, use TitledSingleSelectEnumSchema): type 'string'; title?, description?; enum: string[]; enumNames?: string[]; default?: string (l.2876-3118).
methods.result: ElicitResult (carried in inputResponses under the same key; NOT a Result — no resultType/_meta fields declared, l.3134-3149): action: 'accept'|'decline'|'cancel' (required); content?: {[k:string]: string|number|boolean|string[]} — only present when action=='accept' and mode=='form'; omitted for url mode.
methods.notes: URL mode accept means user consented to open the URL, not that the out-of-band interaction completed; the server learns completion by inspecting requestState (or its own state) on retry and may return another InputRequiredResult (elicitation.md 'URL Mode'). Clients SHOULD offer manual retry/cancel controls.

methods.name: sampling/createMessage (input request) — DEPRECATED (SEP-2577)
methods.direction: server->client (embedded in InputRequiredResult.inputRequests; NOT a JSON-RPC request)
methods.capability_gate: Client MUST declare ClientCapabilities.sampling ({} baseline; sampling.tools for tools/toolChoice; sampling.context for includeContext thisServer/allServers). Server MUST NOT send tool-enabled sampling requests to clients without sampling.tools (sampling.md 'Tools in Sampling'); client MUST return an error if tools/toolChoice present without sampling.tools declared (schema.ts l.2143, 2148). InvalidParams -32602 for 'Missing tool result or tool results mixed with other content' (l.371).
methods.params: CreateMessageRequest = { method: 'sampling/createMessage'; params: CreateMessageRequestParams } (l.2185-2188). CreateMessageRequestParams (does NOT extend RequestParams; no _meta declared, l.2104-2152): messages: SamplingMessage[] (required); modelPreferences?: ModelPreferences; systemPrompt?: string; includeContext?: 'none'|'thisServer'|'allServers' (default 'none'; thisServer/allServers deprecated SEP-2596); temperature?: number; maxTokens: number (required); stopSequences?: string[]; metadata?: JSONObject; tools?: Tool[]; toolChoice?: ToolChoice {mode?: 'auto'|'required'|'none', default {mode:'auto'}}. SamplingMessage: role: 'user'|'assistant'; content: SamplingMessageContentBlock | SamplingMessageContentBlock[]; _meta?: MetaObject (l.2245-2249). SamplingMessageContentBlock = TextContent | ImageContent | AudioContent | ToolUseContent | ToolResultContent. ToolUseContent: type 'tool_use'; id: string; name: string; input: {[k]: unknown}; _meta? (clients SHOULD preserve for caching). ToolResultContent: type 'tool_result'; toolUseId: string (MUST match a prior ToolUseContent.id); content: ContentBlock[]; structuredContent?: unknown; isError?: boolean (default false); _meta? (SHOULD preserve). ModelPreferences: hints?: ModelHint[] ({name?: string}); costPriority?, speedPriority?, intelligencePriority?: number in [0,1] (l.2508-2579).
methods.result: CreateMessageResult extends SamplingMessage (NOT Result; no resultType, l.2210-2228): role; content (single block or array); _meta?; model: string (required); stopReason?: 'endTurn'|'stopSequence'|'maxTokens'|'toolUse'|string (open string).
methods.notes: Human-in-the-loop SHOULD (sampling.md). Client MUST respect maxTokens; MAY modify/ignore temperature, stopSequences, metadata, systemPrompt, includeContext, modelPreferences. Hints evaluated in order (first match) — MUST (l.2511-2513); hints treated as substrings, MAY map across providers. Tool-result user messages MUST contain ONLY tool_result blocks; every assistant message with tool_use MUST be followed by a user message of exactly matching tool_results before any other message (sampling.md 'Message Content Constraints'). On error/decline the client simply does not retry (sampling.md 'Error Handling'). Messages SHOULD NOT be retained between separate requests.

methods.name: roots/list (input request) — DEPRECATED (SEP-2577)
methods.capability_gate: Client MUST declare ClientCapabilities.roots ({} — no listChanged sub-field exists in 2026-07-28) on each request (roots.md 'Capabilities'); servers SHOULD check the capability before use.
methods.params: ListRootsRequest = { method: 'roots/list'; params?: { _meta?: MetaObject } } (l.2718-2723). params entirely optional.
methods.result: ListRootsResult = { roots: Root[] } (NOT Result; no resultType, l.2742-2744). Root: uri: string (required; MUST start with 'file://'); name?: string; _meta?: MetaObject (l.2758-2775).
methods.notes: notifications/roots/list_changed no longer exists (changelog Major 5). Roots are informational, not access control (roots.md). Clients MUST only expose roots with appropriate permissions and validate root URIs against path traversal.

methods.name: notifications/cancelled
methods.direction: notification c->s (primary); notification s->c ONLY to terminate a subscriptions/listen stream (stdio)
methods.params: CancelledNotificationParams extends NotificationParams: _meta?: NotificationMetaObject; requestId: RequestId (string|number, required; MUST correspond to a request the client previously issued — or, server-sent, the id of the subscriptions/listen request); reason?: string (MAY be logged/shown) (l.620-651)
methods.notes: Streamable HTTP: client cancels by closing the SSE response stream; server MUST treat disconnect as cancellation; no notifications/cancelled expected. stdio: client MUST send notifications/cancelled (cancellation.md 'Transport-Specific'). Servers MUST NOT use this notification to cancel anything else (l.637). Invalid/unknown/late cancellations SHOULD be ignored; client SHOULD ignore a response arriving after it cancelled.

methods.name: notifications/progress
methods.direction: notification s->c (spec text: 'server MAY send progress notifications to report status of requests the client has issued'; schema says 'inform the receiver')
methods.capability_gate: none; opt-in per request via params._meta.progressToken (string|number, unique across active requests)
methods.params: ProgressNotificationParams extends NotificationParams: _meta?; progressToken: ProgressToken (required); progress: number (required; MUST increase each notification; MAY be float); total?: number (MAY be float); message?: string (SHOULD be human-readable) (l.1009-1043)
methods.notes: Flows on the response stream of the originating request, not on subscriptions/listen (changelog Major 4). MUST only reference tokens of active in-progress requests; MUST stop after completion (progress.md). Receiver is not obligated to send progress (l.65). Timeout clocks MAY be reset on progress but a maximum timeout SHOULD always be enforced (cancellation.md 'Timeouts').

methods.name: notifications/message — DEPRECATED (SEP-2577)
methods.capability_gate: Server that emits MUST declare ServerCapabilities.logging ({}; deprecated). Client opts in per request via _meta['io.modelcontextprotocol/logLevel'] (LoggingLevel; deprecated). Server MUST NOT emit for requests lacking that key (l.102-104; logging.md).
methods.params: LoggingMessageNotificationParams extends NotificationParams: _meta?; level: LoggingLevel ('debug'|'info'|'notice'|'warning'|'error'|'critical'|'alert'|'emergency', RFC 5424 order) (required); logger?: string; data: unknown (required; any JSON) (l.2031-2083)
methods.notes: Request-scoped: MUST be delivered only on the response stream of the request that set the level, before the final response; MUST NOT be delivered on subscriptions/listen or any other stream (logging.md 'Per-request log level'). Unrecognized level -> server SHOULD reject with -32602. logging/setLevel RPC removed. Log messages MUST NOT contain credentials, PII, or internal details aiding attacks.

methods.name: server/discover (capability/extension advertisement)
methods.capability_gate: none — servers MUST implement; clients MAY call (l.654-668)
methods.params: RequestParams: _meta: RequestMetaObject (required keys as for any request)
methods.result: DiscoverResult extends CacheableResult: resultType; supportedVersions: string[] (required); capabilities: ServerCapabilities (required); instructions?: string; ttlMs: number; cacheScope: 'public'|'private'; _meta?: ResultMetaObject ('io.modelcontextprotocol/serverInfo': Implementation SHOULD be present) (l.678-709). ServerCapabilities: experimental?: {[k]: JSONObject}; logging?: JSONObject (deprecated); completions?: JSONObject; prompts?: {listChanged?: boolean}; resources?: {subscribe?: boolean; listChanged?: boolean}; tools?: {listChanged?: boolean}; extensions?: {[extensionId: string]: JSONObject} (keys MUST follow _meta key naming rules with a MANDATORY prefix) (l.793-883). ClientCapabilities (sent per request): experimental?; roots?: {} (deprecated); sampling?: {context?: JSONObject; tools?: JSONObject} (deprecated); elicitation?: {form?: JSONObject; url?: JSONObject}; extensions?: {[extensionId]: JSONObject} (mandatory prefix) (l.716-786).
methods.notes: Extensions negotiation: if one party supports an extension the other does not, the supporting party MUST revert to core behavior or reject with an appropriate error (versioning.md 'Extension Negotiation'). Known extension ids: 'io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks' (adds resultType 'task'), 'io.modelcontextprotocol/ui' (settings {mimeTypes: ['text/html;profile=mcp-app']}), 'io.modelcontextprotocol/oauth-client-credentials'. Extensions are disabled by default in SDKs and require explicit opt-in (extensions/overview.md).

methods.name: subscriptions/listen + notifications/subscriptions/acknowledged (referenced by cancellation/progress rules)
methods.capability_gate: listChanged/subscribe server capability flags determine which filter types the server honours (unsupported types omitted from acknowledgement, l.1371-1379)
methods.params: SubscriptionsListenRequestParams: _meta; notifications: SubscriptionFilter {toolsListChanged?, promptsListChanged?, resourcesListChanged?: boolean; resourceSubscriptions?: string[]} (l.1270-1302). SubscriptionsAcknowledgedNotificationParams: notifications: SubscriptionFilter (subset honoured).
methods.result: SubscriptionsListenResult: resultType; _meta: SubscriptionsListenResultMetaObject with REQUIRED 'io.modelcontextprotocol/subscriptionId': RequestId (== the listen request id); sent only on graceful teardown (l.1326-1364).
methods.notes: Every notification delivered on the stream MUST carry _meta['io.modelcontextprotocol/subscriptionId'] (l.120-134); the acknowledged notification MUST be the first message carrying that id (l.1386-1391). notifications/progress and notifications/message are NOT delivered on this stream.

requirements.text: Send server-to-client requests (roots/list, sampling/createMessage, elicitation/create) only via the MRTR pattern; the previous server-initiated request pattern is no longer supported.
Return an InputRequiredResult on any client request other than prompts/get, resources/read, tools/call.
Include at least one of inputRequests or requestState in every InputRequiredResult.
inputRequests keys are server-assigned and unique within the scope of the request; values are exactly one of ElicitRequest, CreateMessageRequest, ListRootsRequest.
Set resultType 'input_required' on InputRequiredResult and 'complete' on ordinary results; servers implementing 2026-07-28 MUST include resultType on every result.
Treat an absent resultType (server implementing an earlier protocol version) as 'complete'; treat any unrecognized resultType value as invalid.

Include in inputRequests any request kind/mode the client has not declared in _meta clientCapabilities (e.g. no elicitation/create if no elicitation capability; no url mode if only form declared; no tools in sampling without sampling.tools).
requirements.cite: mrtr.md Server Req 7; elicitation.md 'Capabilities'; sampling.md 'Tools in Sampling'

requirements.text: Treat requestState received from a client as attacker-controlled input; if it influences authorization, resource access or business logic, protect its integrity (HMAC/AEAD) and reject state failing verification.
Embed in the integrity-protected requestState and verify on receipt: the authenticated principal, a short TTL, and an identifier of the originating request (method + digest of salient params).
Enforce single-use of a requestState server-side where at-most-once consumption is required (e.g. one-time redemptions).
Assume clients will fulfill inputRequests or retry the original request.
If InputRequiredResult contains inputRequests, construct all requested inputs before retrying; if it does not, the client MAY retry immediately.
Echo requestState back exactly (byte-for-byte) on the retry; MUST NOT inspect, parse, modify or make assumptions about it; MUST NOT include requestState in the retry if none was returned.
Use a different JSON-RPC id for the retry than for the initial request.
Use inputRequests/requestState from one InputRequiredResult on any request other than the retry of that original request (e.g. parallel requests).
For each key in the InputRequiredResult.inputRequests, place the corresponding response under the same key in params.inputResponses of the retry.

Validate inputResponses is well-formed and parseable; return JSON-RPC errors for protocol errors; ignore unrecognized extra entries; if required information is missing, respond with a new InputRequiredResult rather than an error.
Use form-mode elicitation for sensitive information (passwords, API keys, access tokens, payment credentials); MUST use URL mode for such interactions.

Provide UI that makes clear which server is requesting information; provide clear decline and cancel options; for form mode allow review/modification before sending; for URL mode clearly display target domain/host and obtain consent before navigation.
Declare the elicitation capability in _meta clientCapabilities on each request when supporting elicitation; support at least one mode; treat {} as {form:{}}.
Treat elicitation requests without a mode field as form mode.
Form-mode requests MUST specify mode 'form' or omit mode, and include requestedSchema (flat object, primitive properties only); URL-mode requests MUST specify mode 'url', message, and a valid url.
Pre-populate form fields with schema default values when defaults are supported; validate all responses against the provided schema.
Validate received elicitation data matches the requested schema.
ElicitResult.action is one of accept|decline|cancel; content only when action=='accept' and mode was form; omitted for URL mode.
Handle user decline/cancel and client failure to process elicitation; SHOULD NOT assume elicitation always succeeds.
Bind elicitation requests to the client and user identity; if state is stored, protect it and derive user identity from MCP authorization credentials (e.g. sub) for remote servers.

Include sensitive end-user information (credentials, PII) in a URL-mode url; MUST NOT provide a pre-authenticated URL; SHOULD NOT include clickable URLs in form-mode fields; SHOULD use HTTPS outside development.

Pre-fetch a URL-mode url or its metadata; MUST NOT open it without explicit user consent; MUST show the full URL before consent; MUST open it in a manner that prevents the client/LLM from inspecting content or inputs; SHOULD highlight the domain, warn on Punycode/suspicious URIs, and not render URLs clickable except the url field.

Verify the identity of the user who opens a URL-mode URL and ensure it is the same user who started the elicitation (phishing mitigation); the mechanism MUST be resilient to attacker modification of the URL.

Rely on URL-mode elicitation to authorize users for the MCP server itself; MUST NOT transmit third-party credentials obtained via URL mode to the client; MUST NOT use the client's credentials for third-party services (token passthrough).
requirements.cite: elicitation.md 'URL Mode Elicitation for OAuth Flows'

requirements.text: Provide manual controls to retry or cancel the original request after a URL-mode accept, since completion is only discovered on retry.
Declare sampling (and sampling.tools / sampling.context as applicable) in _meta clientCapabilities to receive sampling / tool-enabled / context-inclusion sampling requests.
Return an error if tools or toolChoice is present in a sampling request but sampling.tools was not declared.
Respect maxTokens in sampling requests.

Evaluate ModelPreferences.hints in order (first match wins); SHOULD prioritize hints over numeric priorities but MAY use priorities to break ties; SHOULD treat hint name as substring; MAY map to another provider's model.

A user message containing tool_result blocks MUST contain only tool_result blocks; every assistant message containing tool_use blocks MUST be followed by a user message consisting entirely of tool_result blocks matching every tool_use id, before any other message; server MUST respond to stopReason 'toolUse' accordingly.
requirements.cite: sampling.md 'Message Content Constraints', 'Security Considerations' 6; schema.ts l.2451

requirements.text: Omit includeContext or use 'none'; only use 'thisServer'/'allServers' if client declares sampling.context (deprecated values).
Keep a human in the loop for sampling: review/edit prompts before sending and review responses before returning; implement approval controls, rate limiting, iteration limits for tool loops.
Preserve _meta on ToolUseContent and ToolResultContent when replaying them in subsequent sampling requests (caching optimizations).

Adopt Sampling, Roots or Logging in new implementations; existing implementations SHOULD migrate (LLM provider APIs; tool params/resource URIs/config; stderr/OpenTelemetry). Features remain for >=12 months (earliest removal: first revision on/after 2027-07-28).
requirements.cite: sampling.md/roots.md/logging.md deprecation Warnings; deprecated.md; schema.ts @deprecated markers l.106,724,736,801,2022,2049,2069,2098,2157,2179,2204,2239,2252,2400,2439,2502,2560,2712,2736,2752

requirements.text: Declare roots capability in _meta clientCapabilities on each request when supporting roots; Root.uri MUST be a file:// URI.
Only expose roots with appropriate permissions; validate root URIs against path traversal; implement access controls; monitor root accessibility.
Check for roots capability before use; respect root boundaries; validate paths against roots; handle roots becoming unavailable; cache root information appropriately.
Declare ServerCapabilities.logging when emitting notifications/message.

Emit notifications/message for a request whose _meta lacks 'io.modelcontextprotocol/logLevel'; when present, MAY emit at or above that level only on that request's response stream before the final response; MUST NOT deliver on subscriptions/listen or any other stream.
Reject a request whose logLevel value is not a recognized level with -32602; internal errors -32603; rate limit log messages; remove sensitive information.
Log messages MUST NOT contain credentials/secrets, PII, or internal system details aiding attacks.
Send notifications/cancelled (stdio) to terminate a previously issued in-progress request; on Streamable HTTP close the response stream instead (no notification expected).
On Streamable HTTP treat a client disconnect as cancellation of that request.
On stdio, send notifications/cancelled referencing the request ID to cancel (including on timeout).
Send notifications/cancelled referencing the subscriptions/listen request ID when tearing down that stream (stdio); MUST NOT send notifications/cancelled for any other purpose.
Cancellation notifications MUST only reference requests previously issued by the client and believed still in progress.
On receiving cancellation: stop processing, free resources, and not send a response; MAY ignore if request unknown/completed/uncancellable.
Ignore any response to a cancelled request arriving afterward; ignore invalid cancellation notifications (unknown ids, completed, malformed).
Handle cancellation race conditions gracefully (notification may arrive after completion/response).

Establish timeouts for all sent requests; cancel and stop waiting on expiry; SDKs SHOULD allow per-request timeout configuration; MAY reset the clock on progress but SHOULD enforce a maximum timeout regardless.
progressToken MUST be a string or integer and unique across all active requests.
progress value MUST increase with each notification even if total unknown; notifications MUST only reference tokens of active in-progress requests and MUST stop after completion.
Choose not to send progress, send at any frequency, omit total.
Track active progress tokens; rate limit progress notifications.

Every request's params._meta MUST carry 'io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion' (string) and 'io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities' (ClientCapabilities; {} means no optional capabilities); SHOULD carry 'io.modelcontextprotocol/clientInfo' unless configured otherwise.

Reject a request missing required _meta fields with -32602 (HTTP 400); MUST NOT infer capabilities from prior requests; if a required client capability is missing return MissingRequiredClientCapabilityError -32021 with data.requiredCapabilities (HTTP 400); if protocol version unsupported return UnsupportedProtocolVersionError -32022 with data.supported/requested (HTTP 400); on HTTP the _meta protocolVersion MUST match the MCP-Protocol-Version header else 400.
Include 'io.modelcontextprotocol/serverInfo' (Implementation) in every result's _meta unless configured otherwise.
Use clientInfo/serverInfo to change behavior or for security decisions (self-reported, unverified).

_meta key names: optional prefix = dot-separated labels (start letter, end letter/digit, interior letters/digits/hyphens) followed by '/'; second label 'modelcontextprotocol' or 'mcp' is reserved; name (unless empty) starts/ends alphanumeric, interior may include '-', '_', '.'; implementations MUST NOT make assumptions about values at reserved keys; SHOULD use reverse-DNS prefixes.

Extension identifiers in capabilities.extensions MUST follow _meta key naming rules with a MANDATORY prefix; when one party supports an extension the other does not, the supporting party MUST revert to core behavior or reject with an appropriate error.
_meta keys 'traceparent', 'tracestate', 'baggage' (unprefixed exception) MUST follow W3C Trace Context / W3C Baggage formats when present.

Emit error codes -32002 or -32042 in this protocol version; MUST NOT emit undefined codes in -32020..-32099; MUST use defined codes only with their specified meanings; new codes SHOULD be allocated outside -32768..-32000. Clients SHOULD still accept -32002 from legacy servers.
Return MethodNotFound -32601 for methods not implemented or gated behind an unadvertised server capability; -32021 (not -32601) when a required CLIENT capability is missing.

Every notification delivered on a subscriptions/listen stream MUST carry _meta['io.modelcontextprotocol/subscriptionId'] (the listen request's JSON-RPC id); MUST NOT send notification types not opted in; acknowledgement MUST precede any notification for that subscription.

wire_details: resultType values: "complete", "input_required" (core); extensions may add e.g. "task" (io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks); unrecognized value MUST be treated as invalid; absent => "complete" (legacy servers)

InputRequiredResult JSON shape: {"resultType":"input_required","inputRequests":{"<key>":{"method":"elicitation/create"|"sampling/createMessage"|"roots/list","params":{...}}},"requestState":"<opaque string>"} — input request objects carry NO jsonrpc/id
Retry params additions: "inputResponses":{"<key>":<ElicitResult|CreateMessageResult|ListRootsResult>}, "requestState":"<echoed>" — allowed on tools/call, prompts/get, resources/read params

Removed method/notification names (must NOT be relied upon in 2026-07-28): "initialize", "notifications/initialized", "ping", "logging/setLevel", "notifications/roots/list_changed", "notifications/elicitation/complete", "resources/subscribe", "resources/unsubscribe", "tasks/*" (moved to extension)

Reserved _meta keys: "progressToken", "io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion" (request, required), "io.modelcontextprotocol/clientInfo" (request, SHOULD), "io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities" (request, required), "io.modelcontextprotocol/logLevel" (request, optional, deprecated), "io.modelcontextprotocol/serverInfo" (result, SHOULD), "io.modelcontextprotocol/subscriptionId" (notifications on listen stream + SubscriptionsListenResult, required there), "traceparent", "tracestate", "baggage" (OTel, unprefixed exception)

Reserved _meta prefix rule: any prefix whose SECOND label is "modelcontextprotocol" or "mcp" (e.g. io.modelcontextprotocol/, dev.mcp/, org.modelcontextprotocol.api/, com.mcp.tools/); com.example.mcp/ is NOT reserved

Error codes: -32700 PARSE_ERROR, -32600 INVALID_REQUEST, -32601 METHOD_NOT_FOUND, -32602 INVALID_PARAMS (unknown tool/prompt, bad args, bad cursor, invalid log level, undeclared elicitation mode, sampling tool-result violations, missing required _meta, resource not found), -32603 INTERNAL_ERROR, -32020 HEADER_MISMATCH (HTTP 400), -32021 MISSING_REQUIRED_CLIENT_CAPABILITY (data.requiredCapabilities: ClientCapabilities; HTTP 400), -32022 UNSUPPORTED_PROTOCOL_VERSION (data.supported: string[], data.requested: string; HTTP 400); reserved-never-reuse: -32002 (legacy resource not found), -32042 (2025-11-25 URL elicitation required); -32000..-32019 implementation-defined; -32020..-32099 spec-reserved, allocated sequentially

HTTP header: MCP-Protocol-Version MUST equal _meta['io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion'] else 400 Bad Request (schema.ts l.71-74); Mcp-Method / Mcp-Name headers required on Streamable HTTP POST (changelog Minor 4; details in transport page, not in focus)
LoggingLevel enum (RFC 5424 order): debug, info, notice, warning, error, critical, alert, emergency
ElicitResult.action enum: accept, decline, cancel; ElicitResult.content value types: string | number | boolean | string[]

Elicitation mode enum: "form" (default when absent), "url"; StringSchema.format enum: email, uri, date, date-time; NumberSchema.type: number | integer; multi-select: type "array" with items.enum or items.anyOf[{const,title}]; titled single: oneOf[{const,title}]; legacy enumNames: string[]

Sampling: stopReason standard values endTurn, stopSequence, maxTokens, toolUse (open string); toolChoice.mode: auto (default), required, none; includeContext: none (default), thisServer, allServers (deprecated); content block types text, image, audio, tool_use, tool_result; roles user, assistant; ModelPreferences priorities in [0,1]
ProgressToken: string | number; progress/total: number (floats allowed)
Cancellation on Streamable HTTP = client closes SSE response stream (no message); on stdio = notifications/cancelled {requestId, reason?}
Icons MIME: clients rendering icons MUST support image/png, image/jpeg (and image/jpg); SHOULD support image/svg+xml, image/webp
sdk_implications: Type model: model InputRequest as a discriminated union on method (elicitation/create | sampling/createMessage | roots/list) of bare {method, params} objects WITHOUT jsonrpc/id; model InputResponse (ElicitResult | CreateMessageResult | ListRootsResult) as bare objects WITHOUT resultType/_meta. Do not reuse the JSONRPCRequest/Result envelope classes for them. CreateMessageRequestParams, ElicitRequest*Params have no _meta; ListRootsRequest.params is optional with only _meta?.

Result parsing: every deserialized result must be dispatched on resultType ('complete' | 'input_required' | extension values advertised via capabilities); absent => 'complete' (legacy); unknown => error. Server-side Result serializer must always emit resultType.

Server SDK: allow tool/prompt/resource handlers to return an InputRequiredResult (or throw a typed 'NeedInput' exception) containing inputRequests + requestState; enforce (a) at least one of the two, (b) unique keys, (c) only the 3 permitted request kinds, (d) only on tools/call, prompts/get, resources/read, (e) capability gating against the per-request ClientCapabilities (drop/refuse elicitation without elicitation cap, url mode without elicitation.url, sampling without sampling, tools without sampling.tools, roots without roots) — surface as -32021 MissingRequiredClientCapability when the operation cannot proceed.

Server SDK: provide a requestState helper that serializes handler state and applies HMAC/AEAD with a server key, embedding principal, expiry, and originating method+params digest; verify and reject on retry; expose an opt-out only for cases where tampering can only cause request failure. Never store server-side session state for MRTR (statelessness).

Server SDK: on retry, expose inputResponses to the handler keyed identically; if responses are missing, re-issue InputRequiredResult (not an error); ignore unknown keys; validate ElicitResult.content against requestedSchema (SHOULD) and validate sampling tool-use/tool-result balance.

Client SDK: implement an MRTR driver loop around Call-Tool/Get-Prompt/Read-Resource: on input_required, invoke registered handlers (elicitation form/url handler, sampling handler, roots provider), build inputResponses with same keys, echo requestState verbatim (never parse), re-issue with a fresh id, repeat until complete; cap iterations; never leak inputResponses/requestState into other concurrent requests; provide cancel/retry controls for url-mode elicitation.

Client SDK: compute ClientCapabilities from registered handlers and stamp it plus protocolVersion (and clientInfo unless disabled) into _meta on every outgoing request; treat elicitation {} as form-only; refuse sampling requests with tools/toolChoice when sampling.tools not declared (return error/decline).

Client SDK elicitation: form renderer must support String (minLength/maxLength/format email|uri|date|date-time/default), Number/Integer (minimum/maximum/default), Boolean(default), single-select enum (enum[] or oneOf[{const,title}] or legacy enum+enumNames), multi-select (type array, items.enum or items.anyOf[{const,title}], minItems/maxItems, default string[]); reject nested objects/arrays of objects; pre-populate defaults; produce content values as string|number|boolean|string[]; URL mode: show full URL, no prefetch, explicit consent, open in non-inspectable browser, return {action:'accept'} without content.

Client SDK sampling (deprecated but required for dual-era/back-compat): implement ModelPreferences hint matching (ordered, substring, provider mapping), honor maxTokens, allow user approval hooks before request and before returning result, preserve _meta on tool_use/tool_result across turns, validate tool-result-only user messages, support content as single block or array, return model + stopReason. Mark the whole API surface [Obsolete]/deprecated with SEP-2577 reference.

Logging: server SDK exposes a per-request logger that emits notifications/message only if the incoming request's _meta had io.modelcontextprotocol/logLevel, filtered at/above that level, written to the same response stream before the final response; reject unknown levels with -32602; do NOT expose logging/setLevel; recommend stderr/OTel in docs and mark deprecated.

Progress: server SDK exposes a progress reporter bound to the request's _meta.progressToken (no-op if absent), enforcing monotonic increase and stopping at completion; client SDK generates unique tokens per active request, routes notifications/progress by token to the awaiting call, optionally resets the timeout on progress but enforces a hard maximum.

Cancellation: client SDK on stdio sends notifications/cancelled {requestId, reason} on user cancel or timeout and discards late responses; on Streamable HTTP it aborts the HTTP response stream instead. Server SDK maps stdio notifications/cancelled to a CancellationToken for the handler and suppresses the response; on HTTP it maps client disconnect to cancellation; server sends notifications/cancelled only for subscriptions/listen teardown on stdio.
Timeouts: per-request configurable timeouts on both sides with a global maximum.

Capabilities/extensions: ClientCapabilities/ServerCapabilities types must include extensions: map<string, object> with key validation (mandatory prefix, _meta naming grammar) and experimental maps; extension support must be opt-in and default-off; provide hooks so an extension (e.g. io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks) can register additional resultType values, _meta keys and methods; fallback/reject behavior when peer lacks the extension.
_meta handling: implement a validator for _meta key grammar; treat reserved-key values as opaque; pass through unknown keys; support OTel traceparent/tracestate/baggage propagation.

Error handling: define constants for -32020/-32021/-32022 with typed data payloads; never emit -32002/-32042; accept -32002 from legacy servers; local errors (timeouts) must not be confusable with peer errors.

Dual-era client: detect server era (stdio: probe server/discover; HTTP: inspect 400 body) and, for legacy servers, fall back to initialize handshake where server-initiated JSON-RPC requests (elicitation/create, sampling/createMessage, roots/list with ids) must be handled as real requests with real responses, plus notifications/roots/list_changed, logging/setLevel, ping, notifications/elicitation/complete, elicitationId, -32042 URLElicitationRequiredError.
Schema validation: JSON Schema 2020-12 by default for tool schemas; elicitation requestedSchema is a restricted subset validated by SDK-specific logic; no network $ref dereferencing by default.
legacy_delta: Transport of client-feature requests: 2025-11-25/2025-06-18 — server sends real JSON-RPC requests (ElicitRequest/CreateMessageRequest/ListRootsRequest extend JSONRPCRequest/Request with id) and awaits a JSON-RPC response; 2026-07-28 — embedded as bare {method, params} objects inside InputRequiredResult.inputRequests; responses returned in the retry's params.inputResponses; no server-initiated requests at all (breaking, SEP-2322).

New in 2026-07-28: Result.resultType (required), InputRequiredResult, InputRequests, InputResponses, InputResponseRequestParams (inputResponses, requestState) on tools/call, prompts/get, resources/read. None exist in legacy schemas.

Elicitation URL mode: 2025-11-25 ElicitRequestURLParams has elicitationId: string (required, opaque) and there is a notifications/elicitation/complete {elicitationId} notification and URLElicitationRequiredError (-32042, data.elicitations: ElicitRequestURLParams[]); all three removed in 2026-07-28 (changelog Minor 11); correlation now via requestState. 2025-06-18 has no URL mode at all (ElicitRequest params: message + requestedSchema only; no mode field).

Elicitation schemas: 2025-06-18 EnumSchema is only {type:'string', enum, enumNames?} (no default, no titled oneOf, no multi-select; StringSchema/NumberSchema have no default); 2025-11-25 introduced Untitled/Titled Single/MultiSelect enum schemas, LegacyTitledEnumSchema and default fields; 2026-07-28 keeps 2025-11-25 shapes unchanged. ElicitResult.content in 2025-06-18 is string|number|boolean only; 2025-11-25+ adds string[].
ElicitResult / CreateMessageResult / ListRootsResult: legacy versions extend Result (carry _meta and, for JSON-RPC, jsonrpc/id); in 2026-07-28 they are bare objects without resultType/_meta.

Elicitation/sampling params in 2025-11-25 extend TaskAugmentedRequestParams (task?: {ttl?}); tasks moved to extension io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks in 2026-07-28 and removed from core params. ClientCapabilities.tasks / ServerCapabilities.tasks removed; replaced by extensions map.

Capabilities: 2025-11-25 ClientCapabilities.roots = {listChanged?: boolean}; 2026-07-28 roots = {} (no listChanged) and notifications/roots/list_changed removed. sampling {context?, tools?} and elicitation {form?, url?} shapes are the same in 2025-11-25 and 2026-07-28 (2025-06-18 had sampling: object, elicitation: object with no sub-keys and no tools-in-sampling). experimental values typed JSONObject vs object. New extensions?: map on both capability objects.
Capabilities are declared per request in _meta['io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities'] (2026) instead of once in initialize (legacy); servers MUST NOT infer from prior requests.

Sampling tools/toolChoice/ToolUseContent/ToolResultContent and stopReason 'toolUse': introduced in 2025-11-25, unchanged in 2026-07-28; absent in 2025-06-18 (SamplingMessage.content single Text|Image|Audio; stopReason endTurn|stopSequence|maxTokens|string). includeContext thisServer/allServers: soft-deprecated 2025-11-25, formally Deprecated 2026-07-28 (SEP-2596).

Deprecation status: Sampling, Roots, Logging fully active in 2025-11-25; Deprecated in 2026-07-28 (SEP-2577), earliest removal first revision on/after 2027-07-28. A dual-era SDK must keep them functional.

Logging: 2025-11-25 has logging/setLevel request (SetLevelRequestParams.level) and notifications/message may be sent automatically if no setLevel was received; 2026-07-28 removes logging/setLevel, uses per-request _meta logLevel, and forbids notifications/message without it; scoped to the request's response stream.

Cancellation: legacy notifications/cancelled is bidirectional for any request (with note not to use for tasks); 2026-07-28 restricts server-sent cancellation to subscriptions/listen teardown and makes HTTP cancellation = closing the stream. Legacy 'MUST NOT cancel initialize' rule is moot (initialize removed).
Progress: semantics unchanged (progressToken in _meta; progress/total/message); 2026-07-28 clarifies progress flows on the originating request's response stream, never on subscriptions/listen.
Error codes: -32002 resource-not-found (legacy) replaced by -32602; -32042 (2025-11-25) removed; new -32020/-32021/-32022 (renumbered from draft -32001/-32003/-32004).

Removed core methods vs 2025-11-25: initialize, notifications/initialized, ping, logging/setLevel, notifications/roots/list_changed, notifications/elicitation/complete, resources/subscribe, resources/unsubscribe, tasks/get|result|cancel|list, notifications/tasks/status; added: server/discover, subscriptions/listen, notifications/subscriptions/acknowledged.

Era detection for dual-era clients: stdio probe with server/discover (non-modern error/timeout => legacy => initialize); HTTP: modern request then inspect 400 body for recognized modern error; cache era per server process/origin (versioning.md 'Backward Compatibility').
open_questions: schema.ts declares no _meta on CreateMessageRequestParams / ElicitRequest*Params and only an optional _meta on ListRootsRequest.params; whether SDKs should accept/forward _meta (e.g. progressToken, OTel keys) on embedded input requests is unspecified.

ElicitResult, CreateMessageResult and ListRootsResult are not Result subtypes in 2026-07-28 (no resultType/_meta). Whether an SDK should tolerate legacy-shaped responses containing _meta inside inputResponses (spec says unrecognized extra data SHOULD be ignored) is implied but not explicit.

The schema comment for InputRequiredResult uses plain (non-doc) comments for inputRequests/requestState; schema.json generation of descriptions for these fields should be verified against 2026-07-28_schema.json.

How a client should respond when it cannot fulfil an inputRequest (e.g. user declines sampling): sampling.md/roots.md say the client 'does not need to replay'; for elicitation, decline/cancel actions exist. Whether a client MAY retry with a partial inputResponses map (omitting a key) and what the server should do is only covered by the SHOULD 're-request missing info' rule.

The exact HTTP mapping for MRTR retries (same POST endpoint, headers Mcp-Method/Mcp-Name, x-mcp-header extraction for retries) lives in the Streamable HTTP page (out of this focus) and should be cross-checked by the transport extraction.

Sampling ToolChoice 'required'/'none' enforcement and iteration limits are SHOULD-level; no error code is specified for a client refusing a sampling request (unlike tools-without-capability which is an unspecified 'error').

notifications/progress direction: schema text says 'inform the receiver' (bidirectional wording) while progress.md speaks only of server->client; whether a client may send progress for input requests it is fulfilling is unspecified (and moot under MRTR since input requests are not in-flight JSON-RPC requests).

The io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks extension defines resultType 'task', methods tasks/get, tasks/update and its own _meta keys; the full normative text is in the ext-tasks repository and was not extracted here.
LegacyTitledEnumSchema is marked 'will be removed in a future version' but is not listed in the deprecated features registry; its lifecycle status is ambiguous.
